svg.desc: A third stage uses power 3 to reveal a flattened crossing. Other factors stay nonzero nearby. Static design sketch showing two selected states. Read the learning plan for the full interaction.
svg.text: FG-D2 / Crossing, touching and repeated roots
ANNOTATED DESIGN SKETCH · selected states, not a production screen
Compare signs either side of x=1.
The sign changes across the simple root.
Keep the root; change its multiplicity.
The graph touches at 1 and keeps its nearby
